verdict.rationale: Error reporting on failed conversions is a fair question for an image conversion tool, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents ImageMagick's error messages, exit codes, exceptions, or warnings for unsupported features or corrupt input. Adjacent features such as image identification and security policies do not count as failure reporting.

support.subject: As a developer, a failed conversion reports why it failed (unsupported feature, corrupt input) instead of silently emitting a broken file
